svg.aria-label: Observation or evaluation? Two cards. Left, OBSERVATION · a camera: a detailed camera with flash, viewfinder, red record light, ringed lens and leather strap projects a beam into a camera frame showing a meeting scene — a person at a table looking at a phone, a wall clock, a badge reading 5 times. Label: facts · numbers · times · places. Quote: I noticed that you looked at your phone five times during the meeting yesterday. Right, EVALUATION · a judge: a judge in a white wig and dark robe strikes a wooden gavel on a sound block at the bench. The words always, never and every time are crossed out. Quote: Omar is always on his phone during meetings.
svg.title: Observation or evaluation?
